entry.title: Research Edition 1: Does the Official Code-Review Plugin Still Help?
entry.summary: We tested Anthropic's official code-review plugin for Claude Code against a simple one-paragraph request, on 15 real code changes and two current AI models. Without the plugin, each model found about twice as many known mistakes, for less money.
